messages:
Alex K.: heads up — enterprise customer (acct: acme-corp) reports rerank endpoint returning identical scores across different candidates after last week's SDK upgrade. They say it worked fine yesterday.
Emily R.: hi Alex — can you paste the request body and model id they used? any request ids from our logs?
Alex K.: here's the payload they sent (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "rerank-latest",
  "query": "Which API has lower latency?",
  "candidates": [
    "Model X is lower latency",
    "Model Y is lower latency",
    "Model Z is lower latency"
  ]
}
```
Alex K.: they said response looked like:
```json
{"scores":[0.5,0.5,0.5],"ranking":[0,1,2]}
```
Alex K.: (they expect distinct scores, not flat). request_id from their client: req-0a1b2c3d
Emily R.: thanks. grabbing logs for req-0a1b2c3d...
Support Bot: log lookup: request=req-0a1b2c3d, project=acme-corp, routed_model=rerank-v1, backend_model_id=rr-tiny-2023, latency=120ms, status=200
Emily R.: interesting — client asked for `rerank-latest` but we routed to `rerank-v1` alias which resolves to `rr-tiny-2023` in prod.
Jordan P.: pinging eng-ml — the symptom (flat identical scores) often happens when a reranker is paired with incompatible candidate embeddings or when an older model returns normalized logits in a different range.
Jordan P.: @Marta can you check if alias `rerank-latest` was recently repointed? logs show alias churn around 2028-06-02 03:14 UTC.
Marta S.: looking... yep — there was a deploy yesterday that flipped `rerank-latest` from `rr-base-2026` -> `rr-tiny-2023` as part of a rollout, but parsing code assumed candidate embedding dims were compatible. That earlier assumption caused score rescaling to be bypassed for tiny models — explains uniform 0.5s.
Emily R.: ok good find. can we confirm this happened only for acme-corp tenant or is global?
Marta S.: global. but only customers using `rerank-latest` alias + sending raw text candidates (not pre-computed embeddings) hit the issue. Customers sending our recommended embeddings still ok.
Alex K.: acme-corp does raw text. they just upgraded SDK which switched them to `rerank-latest` alias automatically.
Jordan P.: mitigation options: 1) quick server-side alias rollback to previous model (rr-base-2026) 2) patch rerank path to run safe rescaling for legacy tiny backends 3) ask SDK team to stop switching alias automatically until fixed.
Emily R.: what's safest short-term?
Marta S.: rollback alias for `rerank-latest` to `rr-base-2026` now, then schedule a non-breaking re-deploy that adds compatibility shim. rollback will restore prior scores.
Jordan P.: agree. I'll prepare rollback. MFA/deploy windows noted. ETA ~ 10m.
Alex K.: tell acme-corp please. even a short note that we're reverting to previous model would help calm them.
Emily R.: sending note to customer now: "We identified that the `rerank-latest` alias was repointed during a rollout which exposed an incompatibility with raw-text inputs. We're rolling back the alias to restore previous behavior and will follow up with a permanent fix. Expect normal scoring within ~15 minutes. Sorry for the disruption."
Alex K.: they replied: "Thanks. Please confirm once scores are back to sensible values. We rely on rerank in our recommendation pipeline."
Support Bot: deploy event: alias rollback started by jordan.p at 1835123505, target=rerank-latest -> rr-base-2026
Marta S.: rollback completed at 1835123540. verifying a few sample requests...
Marta S.: sample request req-0a1b2c3d replay against rr-base-2026 returns scores [0.72,0.45,0.19] — looks good.
Emily R.: updating customer: "Alias rollback completed; can you re-run your request and confirm?"
Alex K.: customer ran it: "Confirmed — scores now sensible. Thanks!"
Jordan P.: root cause: alias repointing during rollout + backend model `rr-tiny-2023` has different scoring range and our compatibility layer accidentally skipped rescaling for tiny backends.
Jordan P.: action items: 
- eng-ml: add compatibility shim/rescaling and unit tests for tiny backends (owner: jordan.p)
- infra/deploy: prevent automatic alias flips without QA gate (owner: marta.s)
- sdk: stop auto-upgrading customers to `rerank-latest` alias for one week (owner: sdk-team)
- support: notify any customers who upgraded in last 48h and used raw text candidates (owner: emily.r)
Emily R.: I've created ticket RN-10288 with those items and linked logs + replay scripts.
Alex K.: thanks team. one more ask from acme: can we expose alias->model mapping in the console so they can audit? they want to pin to rr-base-2026 until this is fully tested.
Marta S.: good customer request. I'll put an optional "model alias history" widget on the console backlog.
Emily R.: closing loop: customer satisfied for now, we'll follow up post-mitigation. marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
Support Bot: thread closed by emily.r at 1835123899
